main_text.l: Essena etiam in præfectura suburbanâ.
Præterea Præpositurae, sacerdotii genus
opimum & honoratum, à Monasterienfi
Præfule [illegible, ~5 letters] ac quietis causâ introduct-
um in hæc loca, quatuor, Farmsuma-
quinta in Hommerziis jamdudum extri-
ta. Collegium quoque canonicorum, aut
ut tum vulgò loquendi mos habebat,
ecclesia collegiata apud Bedumanos cum
fano ibidem illustri, supra fanorum ru-
sticorum modum; cui primus sacerdos
non temerè alius, quàm aut genere aut
doctrinæ titulo conspicuus solet dari,
magno honore atque autoritate in popu-
lo. Denique pastura Baffloa in Hunef-
goniis, itemque Middelsthemia, vicario
munere pro Monasteriensi olim decora-
tæ. Nec ad hæc, quod miretis, Regum
aut Principum liberalitas quicquam con-
tulit, sed rusticæ plebis studia, pauco-
rumque nobilium ista sanè, quàm pro
re ac agri modo majora congessêre[?].
Quibus omnibus si quis addat] Nobili-
tatis domicilia toto agro sparsa, cultu &
mole magnifica, inveniet nihil ad ejus
pulchri-

page.notes: Marginal note beside the first lines: "Præposiu[?]re:" is printed across two lines, the first ending in a doubtful letter. The bold display note "Pa-westdyc" with "(Videinf.)" below it is hard to read; the first word and the place name are uncertain and may be misprinted. The Greek-looking word after "Præfule" is not legible enough to transcribe. The note "Canonici," stands beside the line with "extri-ta.". The first paragraph's opening word and the note "ræ." are read with doubt; the verb "congessêre" is partly illegible. The bracket after "addat" is a printed mark, copied as it stands.
